title: GTA 6 cheat codes? The GTA V codes rumoured to carry over
disclaimer: Rockstar Games has not confirmed any Grand Theft Auto VI cheat codes. The entries below are Grand Theft Auto V single-player (Story Mode) cheats, compiled from IGN and GameSpot and cross-checked against each other. They are not confirmed to work in GTA 6. In GTA V they temporarily disable achievements and trophies for the current session (Rockstar Support). They do not work in GTA Online. This compilation is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or associated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Rockstar Support does not publish a public list of the codes themselves.
scope: Single-player Story Mode cheat codes only: PC typed words, in-game phone numbers, and PlayStation / Xbox button combos where a cited source gives them. No hacks, trainers, mod menus, money glitches, downloads, or online/multiplayer exploits.

counts.note: Instagram and some round-ups say '35 codes'. This file includes 33 cheats that IGN and GameSpot both confirm at least in part. Three extras often used to reach 35 (BMX, the JRTALENT Director Mode code, and IGN's 'random explosion' number) could not be cross-checked and were dropped.

rockstar_support.role: Official policy only — Rockstar Support does not publish a public list of GTA V cheat codes. These articles confirm that using cheats temporarily disables achievements, that saving is still allowed, and that unofficial codes are unsupported.

urls.title: Information about saving and achievements while using GTA V cheat codes
urls.use: Saving is allowed when cheats are enabled; achievements are temporarily disabled. Reloading a save or rebooting resets cheats. Some cheats are unavailable in certain situations ('Cheat Denied'). Starting a mission disables off-mission cheats.

urls.title: Issues after using Cheat Codes
urls.use: Rockstar says that unless a code was given in-game or in the manual, it is unofficial and cannot be supported. Recommends not saving after using cheats.

code_lists.title: Full List of GTA 5 Cheats on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox — IGN
code_lists.use: Overview article that points to the IGN wiki list. Does not itself tabulate every code.

prompting_post.title: Instagram post claiming 35 circulating 'GTA 6' cheat codes
prompting_post.use: The post that prompted this compilation. It states that Rockstar has not officially confirmed any GTA 6 codes, and that the rumoured list includes existing GTA V codes such as PAINKILLER, BUZZOFF and COMET. It is not used as a source for any code, combo or phone number.

general: Story Mode / single-player only. These codes do not work in GTA Online.
Using any cheat temporarily disables achievements and trophies for the current session (Rockstar Support). Reloading a save or restarting the game turns that restriction off.
Do not pause the game while entering a button combo. Use the D-pad for directions, and enter the sequence fairly quickly. A confirmation appears above the map if it worked.
how_to_enter.pc: Press the tilde key (~; on some UK keyboards, ¬) to open the cheat console, type the PC word in capitals, and press Enter.
how_to_enter.phone: Open the in-game phone (Up arrow or Up on the D-pad), open Contacts, open the keypad, dial the 1-999 number and call it. You can press * to redial the last number (IGN).
how_to_enter.playstation: Enter the PlayStation button combo during gameplay with a DualShock or DualSense controller. Sequences are the same on PS3, PS4 and PS5 according to IGN.
how_to_enter.xbox: Enter the Xbox button combo during gameplay. Sequences are the same on Xbox 360, Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S according to IGN.

dropped.reason: Listed on IGN (PC word BANDIT, phone 1-999-226-348, and PlayStation/Xbox combos) but not on GameSpot. Left out because it could not be cross-checked.

GameSpot lists JRTALENT / 1-999-5782-5368 with no button combo. IGN does not list this as a cheat code; it documents Director Mode as an Interaction-menu option (M / Touchpad / View), which is not a cheat code. Left out of the code list.
Appears only on IGN's phone list, with no PC word and no button combo. GameSpot does not list it. Left out because it could not be cross-checked.

dropped.effect: Infinite money / money cheats, trainers, mod menus, GTA Online exploits
dropped.reason: IGN states there is no infinite money cheat and that Rockstar wants players to earn money in Story Mode. GameSpot's list also has no money cheat. These are not official single-player cheat codes and were never in scope.

Rockstar has not confirmed any Grand Theft Auto VI cheat codes. The Instagram post that prompted this list says the circulating 'GTA 6' codes (including PAINKILLER, BUZZOFF and COMET) are existing GTA V codes.
